# Captain Aheth Flariel

*Page PDF 11*

THE CORSAIRS OF CAPTAIN FL ARIEL 

## **Captain Aheth Flariel**
Flariel is commander of the Raptor’s Talon and a rising star in the ever-shifting hierarchy of Duriath Helbane’s council. He cuts a dashing figure, with sweeping black locks blowing in the sea breeze and a devilish grin on his face. 

Flariel is a daredevil. He craves excitement and amusement borne of cruelty. He will not suffer boredom — if he did not co mmand a ravenship, he would descend into a life of carousing and debauchery. He channels his desire for excitement into swashbuckling. 

Duriath Helbane grants the irrepressible Flariel greater freedom than the other captains and dreadlords under his command, because he’s proven to be an inventive raider and killed several rivals in entertaining duels. Flariel wants to leave Helbane’s service, and news of the fleetmaster’s plan to sack Tor Elithis has made this more pressing. 

Captain Flariel enjoys taunting others and playing with their emotions, before inflicting horrible cruelties or unsettling them with unexpected mercy. Flariel finds Rakaria’s imperious presence both annoying and alluring. Corvian’s dour viciousness clashes with his need for amusement and he trusts the beastmaster even less than most Druchii.

## Knives for Flariel
One of the Raptor’s Talon sailors is an assassin in disguise. Ezron Nightstrider was hired by Captain Qulla, a rival on Helbane’s fleet council. Flariel’s reputation is an obstacle to her ambitions and it is far easier to remove him than arrange an alliance. Ezron aims to stay close to Flariel whenever he goes ashore, observing his movements and looking for the right moment to strike. Should the Characters meet Flariel, there’s a good chance Ezron is there too…
